browserVersionPolicy: Current stable releases; verify actual versions before claiming support. Older releases are outside the initial pilot promise.

criteria.scope: Tested ten-editor API/content workload; not visual page-load time, concurrent browser compilation or a production SLA

framing.exceptions: Only explicitly approved origins; general cross-origin embedding is outside the pilot promise
framing.requiredBeforeClientLaunch: Verify the exact RC.8 candidate or approved later bytes on the selected host after deployment is separately authorized

beforeInvitations: Real approved sender/inbox: invitation receipt, account setup, password reset and sign-in verified
Choose the pilot host and support contact, record actual supported browser versions, and verify site-scoped developer assignments for each builder
Pilot operation and recipient-specific invitation authorization supplied separately
beforeFirstClientLaunch: Published-page smoke on physical iPhone Safari and Android Chrome
If used: full custom-domain HTTPS and applicable CDN lifecycle for the actual hosting path
Accepted framing policy enforced and verified
First client handoff reviewed; backup/restore and support ownership confirmed for the chosen pilot host
beforeLegacyImportOrUpgrade: Representative sanitized backup, associated files, expected data and migration history verified on disposable copies
